landRights: customary use rights confirmed by village land committee (demo)
boundary: walked with the farmer and a neighbour; polygon stored off-chain by the programme

consent.benefitSharing: 80% of every sale to the farmer, 20% to the programme fund
consent.buffer: 10% of each issuance held in the permanence buffer pool
consent.canLeave: farmer may leave the programme at any time

fieldAgent: Verdana field agent (registers the farm on-chain)
